tool_args.rationale: The boundary probe reveals a steep supercritical collapse. Fit the authorized threshold-avalanche law numerically to all paid observations and submit it for fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The high-gradient probe shows a sharp decline and negative output inconsistent with the subcritical smooth branch.
The observed collapse tracks the gradient threshold and the authorized mechanism specifies a gradient-dependent avalanche.
The eight observations span both sides of the threshold and identify the specified five-parameter law; another measurement is unnecessary before confirmation.
It does not resolve the mechanism.
